intro.text: A man linked to Shallan's mother, whom Shallan remembers only in brief, buried flashes from her childhood.
A Skybreaker who follows the Herald Nale, and an associate of Shallan's mother.

items.text: In Ishak 1167 Dreder came to the Davar manor. Shallan took him for a friend of her mother's, but Nale had sent him to make sure she died. After talking with Nale through a seon, he told her mother the girl had to die. When Lin cut his arm, Dreder healed and restrained him; when her mother hesitated, Shallan summoned her Shardblade and killed her, then Dreder.
Shallan buried her memories of that day, recalling only flashes: blood from Dreder's wounded arm staining the carpet, and his body lying beside her mother's.
To protect Shallan, Lin claimed that Dreder and her mother had been lovers and that Dreder killed her and then himself; other rumours said Lin had killed them both in a rage.

appearance.text: Wears a Skybreaker symbol on his sleeve; Shallan thought of him as a foreigner.

personality.text: He takes no pleasure in killing children, but will do it if the law requires.
